summary: Tested the new 'Share my Patch' feature end-to-end. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_share_patch.py: 8/8 PASSED (re-ran as sanity check). Frontend Playwright walk-through: 24/24 steps PASSED covering modal open, create link, copy/open/refresh/delete testids, public preview /p/:shareId (name, region, plants, forecast block, dynamic <title>, top + bottom CTAs), re-share preserves URL after adding a plant, missing share id state, and post-delete 404 -> missing state.
critical_code_review_comments: share.py uses payload.region.dict() (pydantic v1 API). Codebase appears to be on pydantic v2 in other modules; .dict() still works via deprecation shim but consider .model_dump() for forward compatibility.

_PROFANITY_RE uses raw \b but the test string 'My fucking garden' matches via the prefix-not-anchored pattern (no trailing \b) — intentional but means 'classic' false positives like 'Scunthorpe' could be flagged. Acceptable for now; consider a denylist test.

SharedPatch.jsx unmount cleanup resets document.title to 'Patch & Pot' on every effect re-run (because the cleanup runs on dependency change too, not just unmount). Functionally fine because the next effect immediately re-sets it, but a brief title flash to 'Patch & Pot' can occur when month changes. Low priority.

delete_share uses a query-string secret which will land in any access logs / referer headers. For a higher-security feature this would warrant a body or header; for an anonymous, low-stakes share it's acceptable and documented in the router docstring.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage on the preview origin: patchpot.patches.v1, patchpot.patch.<id>.region.v1 (London, UK), patchpot.patch.<id>.garden.v1 (Basil, Tomato, then +Mint). All created share snapshots were deleted at end of run via the modal delete flow; pytest cases self-clean via TEST_ prefix + DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend share router lives at /app/backend/routers/share.py; pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_share_patch.py (8 cases, all passing). Frontend pieces: SharePatchModal.jsx, SharedPatch.jsx, MyGarden.jsx (garden-share-btn next to Download when region is set), App.js route /p/:shareId. localStorage cache key for the share is patchpot.share.<patchId>.v1 holding {share_id, owner_secret}. The share button only renders if BOTH region and patchName are set on the active patch — seed both before driving the UI. Public preview's 'This month' forecast block reuses GuidanceView and can take 20-60s on cold cache for a new region; the share-view DOM (name/region/plants/forecast container + CTAs) renders immediately regardless.
rca of the issue: No issues found; nothing to RCA.
